section.p: I am applying for the Engineer – API / Microservices role at Canonical, as it closely matches my background in designing and operating API-driven platforms, microservice-oriented systems, and integration layers on Linux-based infrastructures.

With more than 25 years of experience in backend and distributed systems, I have designed REST APIs, integration services, and workflow orchestration mechanisms used in production across high-traffic, multi-country platforms. My recent work focuses on schema-driven API orchestration, service integration, and automation, notably through an internal Ballerina-based orchestration engine exposed via OpenAPI and Swagger UI.

Canonical’s emphasis on well-designed APIs, reliability, and long-term maintainability strongly resonates with my engineering approach. I am particularly motivated by building clear service contracts, improving observability and robustness, and contributing to platforms that operate at scale on Ubuntu and cloud environments.

Accustomed to remote collaboration, I value rigorous engineering practices, clear communication, and pragmatic problem-solving. I would be glad to discuss how my experience in API platforms and microservices could contribute to Canonical’s teams.

Kind regards,
Franck Delahaye
